ترتعفين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَعِفِينَ (tartaʕifīna) /tar.ta.ʕi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# تُرْتَعَفِينَ (turtaʕafīna) /tur.ta.ʕa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
